review.summary: The rewrite preserves the operative threshold, declaration contexts, conversion and default, exclusions, scoped repair guidance, and proof requirements; the compressed headings lose no knowledge. A weak coder can make the decision from the coder-facing fields, and activation is deterministic once the declared content-inspection observer supplies the finding. I agree with the auditor's PASS.
